SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT E.*, B.EQUIPTID AS EQUIPTNO, B.EQUIPTNAME, B.SPECIFICATION, B.FACTORYNO, B.STATUS, C.TESTCATEGORYDESC AS TESTCATEGORYDESC, M.ISLOCKED, D.TESTNAME AS TESTNAME, H.METHODNAME AS METHODNAME, H.TESTMETHODBASIS AS TESTMETHODBASIS, H.MAXVERSIONNO AS VERSIONNO, O.ORGNAME, U.USERNAME FROM T_EMC_EQUIPT_TEST_METHOD E LEFT JOIN T_EMC_EQUIPT B ON E.EQUIPTID = B.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST_CATEGORY C ON E.TESTCATEGORYID = C.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST_METHOD M ON E.TESTMETHODID = M.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST D ON M.TESTID = D.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_METHOD H ON E.METHODID = H.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_ORG O ON B.USEDDEPARTMENTID=O.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_USER U ON B.MAINTAINUSERID =U.ID) T
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC

SELECT T.*, C.TESTCATEGORYDESC AS TESTCATEGORYDESC, D.TESTNAME AS TESTNAME, H.METHODNAME AS METHODNAME, H.TESTMETHODBASIS AS TESTMETHODBASIS, H.MAXVERSIONNO AS VERSIONNO FROM T_EMC_EQUIPT_TEST_METHOD T LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST_CATEGORY C ON T.TESTCATEGORYID = C.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST_METHOD M ON T.TESTMETHODID = M.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST D ON M.TESTID = D.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_METHOD H ON T.METHODID = H.ID WHERE T.EQUIPTID = #{id}
